prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: Miniature Beasts Station HOME screen concept, a flat screen design that fills the whole 16:9 canvas edge to edge (the outer 2 percent at left and right is bleed, trimmed later to 1024x600). Not a device photograph: no bezel, no buttons, no hands, no table. Design at 1024x600 first: large shapes, few words, nothing smaller than 14 px type.
STYLE: the approved Station look: softly sculpted volumes, one key light from the upper left, clean three or four step shading, crisp edges, generous space, no noise, grain or texture spray. The Station is a hardware research instrument, not a room or a cottage. Its chrome is cool and precise: matte dark slate and teal-grey panels, thin engraved rules, small round status lamps, engraved labels, readouts drawn as objects. The vivarium is the only warm, saturated, lively element. Full resolution: smooth volumes and real highlights; pixels may be hinted at the edges but no visible pixel grid.
LAYOUT: a thin dark top bar (40 px) and a thin dark bottom line (38 px). Between them TWO PANES divided by one thin engraved vertical rule. LEFT PANE, about 55 percent of the width: the vivarium as a deep glass specimen window filling the pane; the focused resident, Pip, large, about 340 px tall, exactly the supplied Pip, under a warm instrument lamp cone, standing on moss with ferns and a small pool behind; four thin cream corner brackets around Pip; under Pip the name. Small in the shade: a glowtail (teal lizard-like mibi, glowing tail tip) at the left edge, a puffcap (round red-capped mibi with cream spots) at the right edge, and a small empty felt bed with a tiny grey Companion-shaped mark. RIGHT PANE, about 45 percent: a cool slate INSTRUMENT READOUT in four rows, each row one drawn object on a slate plate, larger than usual, with one engraved label and one round status lamp: a SAMPLE BAY hatch with two sealed wooden crates wearing small place stamps and one empty slot; a POD TRAY of six round cups, three holding smooth seed-pods (green, blue, violet), three empty; an INCUBATOR glass dome with a small embryo glowing green inside and five leaf shapes around its plate, two filled bright; a PROBE DOCK, an empty cradle with three Shield plates, two lit and one dark.
TEXT, exactly these and nothing else, cream type on dark: top bar left "Home  T5"; top bar centre three small icons with counts, an amber energy crystal "9", a blue data chip "4", a green essence droplet "6"; top bar right "Companion away · with Dot". Under the focused resident "Pip" large and "hopper · adult" small. Bottom line: orange "✓ Look at Pip" at left, grey "Pip · hopper · adult" in the middle, grey "a puffcap pod waits · needs 2" with a small green droplet at right.
Constraints: no tables, no panels with title bars, no bullet lists, no digits as timers or counts on the bench, no percentages, graphs, DNA helices, letters for genes or progress bars; no logos or wordmarks; no other creatures than the three residents; no people.
preamble: Reference images follow; their roles are stated. Image 1 is the accepted rich Pip: the focused resident's identity and sculpted treatment (charcoal body, cream belly, orange eyes with cream rings, three green leaf crown lobes, plain coat, three-quarter pose). Image 2 is the approved Station concept: take its light model, cleanliness and clean stepped shading, not its layout or content. Image 3 is the approved flat Station screen: take its header grammar (small icons with counts: blue data chip, amber energy crystal, green essence droplet) and its type colours (cream on dark, amber for a need), not its layout.
